konst_key_v22.change: GXPipelineConfigVersion 22. normalize_konst_key() sets every stage's kcSel/kaSel to 0x08 in the key. ShaderInfo.konstStages marks stages with a KONST colour or alpha argument; the shader reads ubuf.konst<N>.rgb/.a, and build_uniform computes them from the live g_gxState.tevStages[N] selection and kcolors (fractions (8-s)/8; K0-K3 rgb; Kn_R/G/B/A broadcast; unsourced encodings 0). The fields sit after the kcolor fields in both the WGSL struct and the writer. Migrations: v19 and same-layout v20/v21 -> v22 through normalize_pipeline_key, merging duplicates. KSEL BP writes call mark_pipeline_state_dirty, so the uniforms are rebuilt.
